name: costingly
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Costingly app on this machine: ask about your own bank and credit-card transactions in plain language.
long_description:
Costingly keeps a private copy of your bank and credit-card transactions in a database on this machine, synced from your banks through Plaid by the Costingly desktop app. This extension only connects Claude Desktop to that app; it holds no data, no keys and no database of its own.

Install and open the Costingly app first. With the app running, Claude can ask about spending, income, balances and accounts, and can start a sync, link or unlink a bank, and check or repair the app's database — all through the app, under its rules. Nothing is sent anywhere: the app answers only on this machine, and only with its own token, which the extension finds by itself.

Leave the two settings blank unless the extension says it cannot find the app; both values are shown on the app's Connect screen.

address.title: Address (leave blank)
address.description: Only if the extension says it cannot find the Costingly app: the address from the app's Connect screen, such as http://127.0.0.1:54400/mcp.

token.title: Token (leave blank)
token.description: Only if the extension says it cannot find the Costingly app: the token from the app's Connect screen. Stored in the OS keychain, never sent to the model.
